assessed_concepts: Original source task: Describe how a stack data structure can be used to resume the app that was initially running.
Describe how a LIFO stack supports returning to interrupted work when nested interrupt handling has completed

markscheme.marking_summary: The saved return information/state for each interruption is pushed. Popping the most recently saved state first resumes the most recently interrupted work in the reverse order of suspension.
